title: Oily Overnight Uruguayan Mentaiko Skillet
description: This earthy and aerated Uruguayan dish features mentaiko and is perfect for a midnight craving, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large cast-iron skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the thinly sliced onion and cook for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add the cooked brown rice, pickled mustard greens, and spicy pollock roe to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the oily overnight Uruguayan mentaiko skillet hot, straight from the skillet.
